task.title: Discover workflow runs by immutable workflow identity
task.objective: Complete issues https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/722 and https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/723 with a registry-independent historical query while preserving honest merge-gate evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Return exact workflow-ID matches in ascending run-ID order across every lifecycle and attribution state.
Remain deterministic after reopen and return an empty result when no run snapshots the identity.
Fail closed on malformed candidate history without consulting a current workflow registry.
Record the exact-head CodeRabbit rate-limit merge incident without treating the false green as sufficient review.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused target failed to compile because WorkflowRunStore::list_for_workflow did not exist; the initial test also used an incorrect existing start accessor and was corrected before GREEN.
attempts.patch: Added exact identity, ordering, lifecycle, attribution, reopen, empty-match, and unrelated malformed-history tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Filtering authoritative projections by the immutable workflow ID captured in each start snapshot preserved historical provenance without current registration authority.
attempts.patch: Added list_for_workflow and updated ADR-0012 and milestone documentation; CodeRabbit's wording finding was fixed by distinguishing additional or compound filtering.

attempts.diagnostic: PR 724 merged after its reviewed commit's sole finding was fixed, but before a substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review replaced the false-green rate-limited incremental status.
attempts.patch: Recorded the incident on issue 723 and opened follow-up issue 725 for a repository-owned fail-closed exact-head readiness verifier rather than claiming the rate-limited status was sufficient.

outcome.summary: Exact workflow-identity discovery is implemented and verified, while its premature merge is retained as negative process evidence that motivated an enforceable readiness check.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_run_store

lessons: Immutable snapshot identity supports historical queries even after process-local registry definitions disappear.
Authoritative replay plus exact filtering preserves deterministic all-or-nothing semantics with minimal code.
A substantive review of an earlier commit does not satisfy an exact-head review gate after its finding is fixed.
A green status carrying rate-limit text is false evidence and must never race auto-merge.
Process failures should produce a deterministic guard rather than be normalized as successful precedent.

example.rejection_rationale: The implementation is valid, but merging without substantive exact-head CodeRabbit evidence violated the required readiness contract.
